notes.title: One Year Since the Rise of Rise of Jericho
notes.notes:
[h3]Good morning dear community[/h3]

Today is a very important day for us as it marks exactly one year since the launch of our beloved strategy game Rise of Jericho.

We're now a year older and a year wiser since we launched our first game here on Steam (which by the way you can now find it at a reduced price)

[h2]The beginning[/h2]

[b]Rise of Jericho[/b] is not a game that came out of nowhere. Its concept was conceived under the Free Palestine Game Jam, an event dedicated especially to the creation of video games in support of Palestine, a people that has been invaded, abused and exploited for many years and today, more than ever, suffers from the consequences of western imperialism.

We never imagined that the conflict could escalate as it did this year, but here we are and there seems to be no room for peaceful solutions. And even though Jericho is far from the conflict area, its people still suffer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43951114/d67dfbef639bf4108f8bb78e89f74661057b6d64.jpg[/img]
Herod's Winter Palace in Jericho

Jericho is located in a place that makes it highly coveted by those who crave power. Since the beginning of time, when Jericho was one of the first cities of civilization, of which we all enjoy its fruits today, it has suffered countless invasions and attacks. Even in the Bible, the invasion led by Joshua is glorified.

[h3]And this is how the murder of thousands is justified and canonized.[/h3]

It seems that little has changed in terms of our values, but for the first time in history, we are facing a genocide that is being broadcast live, which gives us the possibility of sharing it and continuing to raise awareness and defend those who have been oppressed.

We hope from the bottom of our hearts that there is a ceasefire as soon as possible to avoid further civilian casualties on both sides of the conflict. As well as, that our message does not cause hatred in anyone who reads it, regardless of where they're reading this from, but rather understanding and empathy.

[h2]Let's talk[/h2]

If you would like to chat with us and the rest of the community, feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/uGzDRVXEMH]join our Discord server[/url], where we cover topics from video games to history and politics.

See you there!

notes.title: Rise of Jericho v1.2 is out!
notes.notes:
I'm very proud to announce that [b]version 1.2[/b] of[b] Rise of Jericho[/b] is now available! It took us a while to complete it, but we feel like the game has [b]improved significantly[/b] and we hope you can appreciate it.

This new version includes a Moon that affects the growth of plants (and that looks beautiful at night), support for new languages ​​such as Turkish, Polish, Russian, German and Arabic, so Rise of Jericho can now be played in the language native to the people who live in this legendary city.

Read the [url=https://sudakagames.com/2023/11/24/rise-of-jericho-v1-2/]full post here[/url]
Illustration by[b] Iván Grandón[/b]

We hope you enjoy playing Rise of Jericho :)

notes.title: Rise of Jericho launch date!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We're very excited to announce that Rise of Jericho is coming out on June 9! So if you haven't had the chance to play the game jam version on our webpage, you'll get to experience the complete game right here on Steam!

So wishlist the game and save the date to build civilization from the beginning in this exciting journey in the city of Jericho, the oldest city in the world...
